findSum4_cb.smtDecl: (declare-fun findSum4_cb ((_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32)) (_ BitVec 32))
findSum4_cb.desc: Takes four numbers and returns the first pairwise sum greater than 5. Checks (first+second), then (second+third), then (third+fourth). If none exceed 5, returns 0.
